name: Threadline
tagline: An editorial clothing store: filter the edit, open a quick view, and check out in three steps.
features: 12 garments, sneakers and bags illustrated in SVG, with colourways
Category tabs, size and price chips, and sorting that re-flow the grid
Quick view with colour and size pickers (sold-out sizes disabled)
Bag drawer with quantities, ₹ totals and a free-shipping thread bar
Three-step mock checkout: address, payment, confirmed
